notes.title: 🎉 MeMic is available now! 🎉
notes.notes:
Today is a huge milestone for us – MeMic has officially launched! 🥳 We want to extend our heartfelt thanks to everyone who has supported us and already joined the game. Your feedback and impressions mean the world to us!

We've been closely monitoring your comments and have already made the first updates:
✔ Fixed an issue with language support
✔ Adjusted some colliders and exit points from objects
✔ Improved overall game stability

This is just the beginning! We're continuously working on improvements and truly appreciate your feedback. Share your thoughts, leave a review, and don’t forget to add MeMic to your wishlist if you haven’t already!

🔗 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3336430/MeMic]Link to store[/url]

Thank you for being part of this journey! 💜
